catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class fits one raw geometry_msgs/msg/Twist publication. cap.motion.mobile_base.v1 requires duration_s and returns measured distance_m, heading_rad and stopped, while /cmd_vel is a durationless velocity setpoint with no completion acknowledgement from the pinned simulator.
No catalogue class observes a geometry_msgs/msg/PoseStamped ground-truth pose. The class is a passive /lunarsim/gt/pose subscription and commands nothing.

cap.sensing.imu.v1 exists, but its resource kind sensor.imu cannot be bound in a Driver whose single device_kind is sensor.camera, which the cap.sensing.image.v1 camera streams require. The extension mirrors the class fields on the same /lunarsim/imu topic.

notes:
BLOCKED (HELPER_MISSING): the pinned LunarSim clone exposes the ROS 2 velocity command only as a geometry_msgs/msg/Twist publication on /cmd_vel and documents no ROS service, action, pause, reset or stop endpoint. A zero-velocity Twist is a client publication, not an acknowledged stop, and the RosDriver bridge reports safe_state.achieved=false for an effectful publication profile without a stop binding. The stock e-stop therefore returns MHS.SAFETY.SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED and keeps the latch; the package does not fabricate a stop. Last gate run 2026-11-05T09:01:02Z, backend fake: G1 pass, G2 pass, G3 pass, G4 pass, G5 pass, G6 fail (G6.ESTOP_FAILED), G7 pass, G8 fail (G8.CONFORMANCE SAFE-028, G8.TEST SAFE-028), G9 skip G9.NOT_RUN. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings.

WHAT WAS AUTHORED: a configuration-only ROS 2 RosDriver over rosbridge (no Python native class). Primary control: x-cap.putvision.cmd_vel.v1 publishes one geometry_msgs/msg/Twist to /cmd_vel, mapping linear_velocity to twist.linear.x and angular_velocity to twist.angular.z (README.md:59-61, 69). Observations: x-cap.putvision.gt_pose.v1 subscribes to /lunarsim/gt/pose (geometry_msgs/msg/PoseStamped, README.md:65-67); x-cap.putvision.imu.v1 subscribes to /lunarsim/imu (sensor_msgs/msg/Imu, README.md:71-73) and converts the message vectors and header stamp; cap.sensing.image.v1 selects three raw Image streams, /lunarsim/camera_left/raw, /lunarsim/camera_right/raw and /lunarsim/camera_depth/depth (README.md:75-81, 83-89, 91-93), through the SDK image artifact path. The three camera streams are the only catalogue binding; because one Driver has one device_kind, the package uses sensor.camera and requests x-caps for the drive, pose and IMU.

WHY THE HELPER CANNOT COMPLETE THIS SURFACE: the pinned README's ROS 2 Topics section (README.md:53-93) lists /cmd_vel and five published topic groups and no service, action, pause, reset or stop. The simulator itself is a release binary downloaded by the Dockerfile (Dockerfile:55-59), not in the clone, so no upstream stop service or action can be cited. Publishing a zero Twist on /cmd_vel is transmission-only (the SDK marks it confirmed=false); declaring it as a safe-state action is invalid (RosDriver safe_state requires a service or action call), and a fake-only zero-velocity receipt would not prove the simulator stopped. This is a genuine upstream stop gap, not a missing fake feature.

LIMITS: the /cmd_vel linear and angular velocities are Limit.operator_required because the README states no maximum; without an operator overlay the command is refused MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET. site-limits.example.json shows the overlay shape with explicitly example values, not device facts. The image max_input_bytes and max_pixels are SDK client policy, not device limits.

SCOPE AND FIDELITY: the fake is a ROS-free analytic contract stand-in, not a capture of simulator traffic; engine 'analytic:ROS-free contract fake with canned placeholder replies (no physics)', F0, determinism none, timestep_ms 0, realtime_factor 0, reset none, no snapshot/restore. All pose, IMU and image values are placeholders; the fake returns a 4x2 BGR8 left/right frame and a 4x2 16UC1 depth frame while the real sizes and encodings are not stated in the clone. NOT COVERED: /lunarsim/camera_left/compressed and /lunarsim/camera_right/compressed (CompressedImage), the simulator's internal physics, timing and renderer, the live ROS graph and any hardware.

No ROS graph, LunarSim process or hardware was run. MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Confirmed the author's block (HELPER_MISSING): the clone holds only a Dockerfile, run scripts, examples and the README; the simulator is a closed binary that the Dockerfile downloads from the project's latest GitHub release (Dockerfile:55-59), and the README's ROS 2 section (53-93) lists /cmd_vel and the published pose, IMU and camera topics with no service, action, pause, reset or stop, so a zero Twist would be an unacknowledged publication. Checked every topic and type against README.md:53-93, the ROS 2 field names (stamp sec/nanosec), the IMU finite, zero-quaternion and stamp checks, the image byte and pixel bounds, both operator_required velocity limits and the example overlay, all 12 facts and the examples (the micro-ROS Pico example subscribes to /lunarsim/imu and publishes only /microROS topics; no shipped code publishes /cmd_vel). One fact added a clone-wide 'the simulator source is not in the clone' clause to Dockerfile:55-59 and hid that the lines download releases/latest: the reviewer narrowed it and the matching gap (driver.py, facts.md) and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json; the gate fails G6.ESTOP_FAILED and G8 SAFE-028, as before (stable digest sha256:c0136e98e18fd5dc3f054c0b0d26941b1625ff7239af21fd0f0563ad3eefda61), and the six package cases pass. The author's R2 is kept as conservative: the clone ships no real-robot path, but /cmd_vel is the generic topic any ROS 2 base on the same graph and DDS domain would obey. The card needs the owner's publication decision (publish_review required; licence not stated (NOASSERTION)); the package may not be published or merged into a published tree before it. For the human reviewer: The simulator binary is not pinned by the clone: the Dockerfile downloads releases/latest, so the simulated rover, its topics and physics can change without a commit; record the release used. run.sh starts the container with --privileged and --net=host, so its ROS 2 graph shares the host network and DDS domain.
